description: Prove the .faf earns its place — measure how much the context is worth, on THIS repo, falsifiably. Questions derive from the project.faf's own populated slots (the .faf is the answer key), so grading is mechanical — no judge, no rubric. action=questions returns the answer-key-safe question set; action=grade takes your answers WITHOUT the .faf (cold) and WITH it (faf), grades both, and returns the cold→with-faf lift with a receipt hash. The delta is the product; the cold number belongs to the absence of context, never to FAF. Reads only.

action.description: questions = get the answer-key-safe question set to answer; grade = submit cold + with-faf answers to score the delta. Default: questions.

cold.description: action=grade: answers produced WITHOUT the .faf (general repo knowledge only). Map of question number → answer string.

faf.description: action=grade: answers produced WITH the project.faf in context. Map of question number → answer string.

fafTokens.description: action=grade (optional): tokens spent answering with the .faf.

model.description: action=grade (optional): the model that produced the answers.

path.description: Project path (optional — the active project if omitted).

name: faf_bench

outputSchema.description: Question set (action=questions) or the cold→with-faf grading and its receipt (action=grade).

misses.description: Slots missed (paths only — no answer key).

protocol.description: in-session — answers are self-reported by the agent under test.

qsetHash.description: Hash of the question set — rides the receipt; same .faf reproduces it.

questions.description: action=questions only — NEVER includes the answer key.

receipt.description: faf-cli's bench receipt — sha256 over the canonical projection; third-party verifiable.

total.description: Number of questions in the set.

title: Grounding Benchmark
